items.title: AWS Releases a Free Local Emulator of AWS Built Entirely by Agents
items.summary: AWS has released AWS Emulator, a free, CC0-licensed local stand-in for more than 200 of its services, generated from its public API models and aimed at the test loops of coding agents. AWS says agents wrote and maintain all of the code and publishes per-release fidelity scores. The docs say it does not evaluate IAM, and practitioners are split on trusting an emulator nobody reviewed. By Steef-Jan Wiggers

items.title: .NET 11 : ASP.NET Core: Union Type Support, OpenAPI 3.2 by Default and Blazor AI Components
items.summary: Microsoft has released ASP.NET Core in .NET 11. The update adds C# union type support in JSON bodies, asynchronous validation for Minimal APIs, OpenAPI 3.2 by default, and SignalR authentication refresh. Blazor gains a CacheView component, client-side validation for static SSR forms, opt-in circuit pause for inactive tabs, and experimental AI components. Zstandard compression is on by default. By Almir Vuk

items.title: Article: Building Reliability Into the Cloud: Observability as the Control Plane for Multi-Region Failover
items.summary: Cloud SLAs promise uptime statistically, not absolutely. This article shows how to treat observability as a control plane that detects regional degradation, triggers automated failover, and confirms recovery rather than paging a human. Covers active-active architecture, DNS TTL pitfalls, composite Prometheus alerting, Route 53 weighted routing, and confirmation loops backed by a real S3 outage. By Saurabh Ahuja
